Needs changes before merge.

The crossing fix works on both fig8 cases. The verifier and the post block stay unchanged. No goldens, UI files, dependencies, or process files changed.

Requested before merge:

1. [P1] Preserve the opening rapid when the crossing helper rebuilds the path (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_emit.rs:144`). The new guard sends OffsetRings and Waterline through `post_crossing_free`. That helper creates `PathBuilder::new(start)` and loses the input builder's `approached` state. If the entry is at X0 Y0, the returned path can start with a plunge. The post then lacks the initial positioning command at clearance. The first feed can start from the actual tool-change position.

   I reproduced this through the public `pocket()` function for both strategies. Use tool diameter 8, stepover 2, top Z0, bottom Z-1, stepdown 1, clearance Z5, climb, and Plunge entry. Set `links.approach.plunge_height = 0`. Generate a rectangle from (-4,-4) to (24,24). Translate the rectangle by the negative XY endpoint of its first rapid. Generate it again. With this PR, the first move is `Plunge`, from (0,0,5) to (0,0,0), at F100. With only the old guard restored, the first move is `Rapid`, from (0,0,5) to (0,0,5). Both strategy checks fail with the PR and pass with the old guard.

   Preserve the builder's opening-rapid contract during each reconstruction. Add regression tests for both strategies. Keep the crossing check enabled.

Local validation:

- Trial merge with upstream main `4e0b9abefcb225595d47d9c69a2482d6359b190f` succeeded.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` selected the motion library and the fig8 app suite.
- Motion library: 402 passed, 6 ignored.
- Motion integration suites: `adaptive_hsm` 2 passed, 5 ignored; `adaptive_orbit_seam` 1 passed; `corner_blend_arc` 9 passed; `machining2d` 66 passed; `optimal_load` 4 passed; `rest2d` 13 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test adaptive_fig8_crossing`: 2 passed. The restored sequential run passed both tests in 134.34 seconds.
- The new motion unit regression passed.

Safety mutations:

- Mutation A removed OffsetRings from the new guard. The unit test failed with `[[5, 7], [15, 17]]`. Both app tests failed with the crossing pairs in the PR body. The restored tests passed.
- Mutation B restored the old guard and removed the new arc tally. The unit test failed with `[[5, 7], [15, 17]]`. The restored test passed.
- The separate opening-rapid probe failed for both strategies with the PR. It passed for both with only the old guard restored.
- No golden files changed. No golden updates required inspection.
- All temporary mutation and probe changes were removed. No GitHub runner was used.

Timing note: both fig8 tests exceeded 60 seconds in the first debug run. Consider smaller fixtures or the release heavy lane. Existing motion tests were also slow on this machine.

Clippy passed for `camcraft-motion --all-targets` and `camcraft-app --all-targets`, each with `-D warnings`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: P1 — Preserve the opening rapid during crossing reconstruction.

Each attempt now copies the input builder. This keeps its opening rapid and notes. The crossing check stays enabled.

Pins:
- `offset_rings_at_origin_keeps_opening_rapid`
- `waterline_at_origin_keeps_opening_rapid`
- `an_arc_crossed_by_a_feed_at_its_plane_is_given_up` now checks the opening rapid after a crossing retry.

Each pin passed. I restored the old helper, and each pin failed. I restored the fix, and each pin passed again.

Validation:
- Motion `machining2d`: 68 passed.
- App `adaptive_fig8_crossing`: 2 passed.
- Clippy passed for both touched crates, `camcraft-cl` and `camcraft-motion`, with all targets and warnings denied.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED. The batch build fails at the existing `crates/tools/src/wire.rs:103` fixture. Its `CuttingRow` initializer has the wrong material type and lacks `stepdown` and `stepover`.
- The extra app clippy check fails at the existing `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106` fixture for the same initializer errors.
- The extra motion library run was stopped after 401 passes and 6 ignored tests. The triangle/neck test did not finish. No failures were reported.

No golden files changed. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed.

New head: `fd8a5a2d6bb5c8ab28466f65e496a94372104ede`.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft.

Needs changes before merge.

The earlier opening-rapid finding is resolved. Each retry copies the complete builder state. The crossing check and the post block remain enabled. The 3D caller keeps its previous contract. No goldens, UI files, dependencies, or process files changed.

Requested before merge:

1. Put the large fig8 tests in the release heavy lane, or reduce their fixtures (`crates/app/tests/adaptive_fig8_crossing.rs:111`, also line 121). Both tests currently run in the regular debug lane. The sequential suite took 206.48 seconds, then 213.96 seconds after restoration. The first case alone exceeded 60 seconds. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, under Testing, requires a smaller fixture or the heavy lane for tests over about 60 seconds. For the heavy-lane option, add ignore reasons that name the lane. Keep both cases and their crossing, verification, and post assertions. Keep the fast motion regression active. Run the moved tests in release mode and record the result in the PR body.

Local validation:

- Trial merge with upstream main `4e0b9abefcb225595d47d9c69a2482d6359b190f` succeeded.
- The gate dry run selected batch because `camcraft-cl` changed. I ran the touched crates and relevant suites directly. I did not run the full batch or release gate.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed for all test targets.
- `camcraft-cl`: 64 tests passed across the library and integration suites. Doc tests passed with no tests.
- Motion library: 402 passed, 6 ignored. The run took 632.14 seconds, including existing slow adaptive tests.
- Motion integration suites: `machining2d` 68 passed; `adaptive_hsm` 2 passed, 5 ignored; `adaptive_orbit_seam` 1 passed; `corner_blend_arc` 9 passed; `optimal_load` 4 passed; `rest2d` 13 passed.
- App `adaptive_fig8_crossing`: 2 passed before mutation, then 2 passed after restoration.
- Clippy passed for all targets in `camcraft-cl`, `camcraft-motion`, and `camcraft-app`, with warnings denied.

Safety mutations:

- Mutation A removed OffsetRings from the new guard. The unit regression failed with `[[5, 7], [15, 17]]`. Both fig8 tests failed with the crossing pairs stated in the PR body. The restored unit and app tests passed.
- Mutation B restored the old reconstruction helper. Both origin-entry tests failed because the first move was `Plunge`. The retry test failed because the first move was `Feed`. All three tests passed after restoration.
- No golden files changed. No golden updates required inspection.
- All temporary mutation edits were removed. No GitHub runner was used. No evidence was committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Move both slow fig8 tests to the release heavy lane.

Both tests now have ignore reasons that name the release heavy lane:

- `adaptive2d_on_fig8_model_in_tight_stock_has_no_crossings_and_posts`
- `adaptive2d_on_fig8_stock_excluding_top_face_has_no_crossings_and_posts`

Both tests keep their crossing, verification, and post assertions. The fast motion regression stays active.

Evidence:

- Release run: 2 passed, 0 failed in 36.74 seconds (190.51 seconds with the build).
- Lane mutation check: Removing both ignore attributes made the ignored-inventory check fail with 0 tests. Restoring them passed with 2 tests. The default debug run reported 0 passed and 2 ignored.
- Fast motion regression: `offset_rings_across_one_micron_vertex_step_post_crossing_free` passed (1 passed, 0 ignored).
- Quick gate: RED after 6.7 minutes. The batch debug build failed at unchanged `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106–107`. Error E0308 requires `Option` for `material`. Error E0063 reports missing `stepdown` and `stepover` fields.
- Clippy: `camcraft-cl` and `camcraft-motion` passed for all targets with warnings denied. The app library and `adaptive_fig8_crossing` target also passed with warnings denied. The app all-targets check failed at the unchanged `wire_tool.rs` fixture with the same gate errors.

The PR body records the release result.

Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Both earlier findings are resolved. Crossing retries preserve the complete builder state, including the opening rapid. Both fig8 tests now name the release heavy lane. Their crossing, verification, and post assertions remain intact. The fast motion regression remains active. The PR body records the release result.

The crossing check and the post safety block remain enabled. The 3D caller retains its existing builder contract. No goldens, UI files, dependencies, build scripts, or process files changed.

Local validation:

- Trial merge with upstream main `fac6c8e8d22cb39bb0a4c18644b4ec1c4dbd2db6` succeeded.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed for all test targets.
- `camcraft-cl`: 64 tests passed. Doc tests passed with no tests.
- Motion unit regressions: the crossing test and the retry test each passed.
- Motion integration suites: `machining2d` 68 passed; `adaptive_hsm` 2 passed, 5 ignored; `adaptive_orbit_seam` 1 passed; `corner_blend_arc` 9 passed; `optimal_load` 4 passed; `rest2d` 13 passed.
- Default debug `adaptive_fig8_crossing`: 0 passed, 2 ignored, as required.
- `cargo test --release -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test adaptive_fig8_crossing -- --ignored --test-threads=1`: 2 passed in 39.36 seconds. After restoration, both passed again in 27.68 seconds.
- Clippy passed for all targets in `camcraft-cl`, `camcraft-motion`, and `camcraft-app`, with `-D warnings`.
- The gate dry run selected batch because the shared CL crate changed. I ran the touched crates and relevant suites directly. Full batch and release gates did not run.

Safety mutations, repeated during this review:

- Mutation A removed OffsetRings from the crossing guard. The fast regression failed with `[[5, 7], [15, 17]]`. Both release fig8 tests failed with the exact crossing pairs recorded in the PR body. The restored unit and release tests passed.
- Mutation B restored reconstruction from a bare cursor, with the original notes. Both origin-entry tests failed because the first move was `Plunge`. The retry test failed because the first move was `Feed`. All three tests passed after restoration.
- No golden files changed. No golden updates required line-by-line inspection.
- All temporary mutation edits were removed. The local trial-merge tree is clean. No evidence was committed to the PR branch or pushed. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Merged by the order of the maintainer of 2026-11-16. No second safety-floor review was made.
